# intro

The homepage's opening paragraphs, and everything above the fork.

Not a hero: no eyebrow pill, no gradient, no call to action. equin is one
developer's proof of concept rather than a product, so the copy states that
plainly and then hands over to [`fork`](../fork/CLAUDE.md), which asks the two
questions. Keep the register an essay's — if a sentence would fit on a pricing
page, it is wrong for this band.
